title: New Home Builder Warranties — Builder Response, Mediation and Builder-Default Terms by Program
content:
Under Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties, workmanship and builder-period systems defects are the builder's obligation. These terms state, program by program, whether such claims go to the builder first, the builder's deadlines, the homeowner's access to mediation of a builder dispute and its fee, and the limit Bridgewell pays when the builder defaults.

## The builder's part

| Program | Claims go to the builder first | Builder must respond within (after tender) | Builder must complete an accepted repair within |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | No | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | Yes | 21 calendar days | 60 calendar days |

## Mediation of a builder dispute

| Program | Mediation available to the homeowner | Mediation fee | Fee refunded when the mediator finds for the homeowner | Request period after the builder's response or missed deadline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | No | 0.00 USD | No | 0 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | Yes | 250.00 USD | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | Yes | 250.00 USD | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | Yes | 250.00 USD | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | Yes | 250.00 USD | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | Yes | 0.00 USD | Yes | 30 calendar days |

## When the builder defaults

| Program | Bridgewell pays for an accepted workmanship or systems defect when the builder defaults | Total limit Bridgewell pays for builder-default claims |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | No | 0.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | Yes | 10000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | Yes | 10000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | Yes | 7500.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | Yes | 10000.00 USD |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | Yes | 20000.00 USD |

## Points of comparison

- The Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty carries no builder obligation in these terms: claims do not go to the builder first, mediation is not available and there is no builder-default payment.
- The Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty sets the shortest builder deadlines (21 and 60 calendar days), charges no mediation fee and carries the highest builder-default limit, 20000.00 USD.
- The Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty carries a builder-default limit of 7500.00 USD, against 10000.00 USD on the other 1-2-10 programs.
